# RT Filters

> RT Filters is an industrial air filter manufacturer specializing in HVAC, cleanroom, and paint booth filtration solutions with a comprehensive product line including HEPA filters, activated carbon filters, and custom filter media.

Based in Guangzhou, China, RT Filters manufactures a wide range of air filtration products for industrial applications including HVAC systems, pharmaceutical cleanrooms, automotive paint booths, and commercial buildings. The company offers both finished filters and raw filter materials with various efficiency ratings and specialized applications.

## Key Topics

- HEPA Filters
- Paint Mist Filters
- Activated Carbon Filters
- High Temperature Filters
- Filter Materials
- HVAC Filtration
- Industrial Air Filters
- Filtration Efficiency (G1-G4)
- Polyester Fiber (PET)
- Polypropylene (PP)
- Fiberglass
- Cleanroom Filters
- Paint Booth Filtration
- Flame-Resistant Media
- Filter Accessories

## Product Catalog

- [Products Overview](https://www.rtfilters.com/en/products.html): RT Air Filtech product catalog: pre-filters, HEPA filters, and filter media.
- [Paint Mist Filter Series](https://www.rtfilters.com/paint-mist-filter-series.html): Paint mist filters for automotive paint booths and overspray collection.
- [High-Temperature Filters](https://www.rtfilters.com/high-temperature-filter.html): High-temperature HEPA and plank filters from RT Air Filtech.
- [Activated Carbon Filters](https://www.rtfilters.com/activated-carbon-filter.html): Activated carbon filters for odor and harmful gas removal in HVAC systems.
- [Pre-Mid Air Filter Series](https://www.rtfilters.com/pre-mid-air-filter-series.html): Pre and medium air filters: panel, bag, and pleated filter options.
- [Panel Filters](https://www.rtfilters.com/panel-filter.html): Panel pre-filters for paint booths and industrial ventilation systems.
- [Pleated Filters](https://www.rtfilters.com/pleated-filter.html): Pleated filters for HVAC systems with high flow and carbon options.

- [Filter Materials Overview](https://www.rtfilters.com/filter-material.html): Filter materials: HEPA rolls, pocket filters, composite and flame retardant media.
- [High-Efficiency Filter Material (HEPA)](https://www.rtfilters.com/high-efficiency-filter-material.html): HEPA filter media and high-efficiency cleanroom filter materials.
- [Medium-Efficiency Filter Material](https://www.rtfilters.com/medium-efficiency-filter-material.html): Medium-efficiency HVAC filter materials: composite and synthetic pocket media.
